symbols.read: Price ticked up to 727.85 from 727.45, extending the grind higher above the 722.40 lower pivot, so the neutral-to-bullish bias holds and the SELL tag stays invalidated. The 1H trend remains up with the last bar positive (725.28→725.88), and the bull FVG stack has firmed to 708.95–721.80, keeping support intact beneath price. The 4H bearish direction and 758.44 upper pivot still frame this as a counter-trend bounce within a bullish regime, not a reversal. Invalidation is unchanged: losing 722.40 into the FVG stack revives the bearish case toward the stale 686.36 target.
